package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Stream hands back a receive-only channel of *Queries instead of a *Queries directly.
func Stream(pool *pgxpool.Pool) <-chan *Queries {
	ch := make(chan *Queries, 1)
	ch <- &Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}
	close(ch)
	return ch
}
